d:
2017 men khoja gaya rahasyamay antar-tarkiy pind oumuaamuaa kahan se aaya? khagolvid robart verik ne havaee ke pain-stars teliskop se ise dekha. lekin oumuaamuaa hai kya? koee dhumketu ya koee kritrim pind?
“dusri duniya se aaee” is vastu ko lekar kaee saval aur ataklen thin. iski raftar itni tez thi ki sury ka gurutviy khinchav ise bandh nahin saka. isse saf tha ki yah kisi dusre star sistam se aaee thi.
